tokens.name: court-green
tokens.usage: Primary brand fill: primary buttons, active tab, app icon ground, headers. Text on it is always on-court-green (6.2:1 light, 4.8:1 dark). The dark value stands off both dark grounds (3.5:1 on surface, 3.1:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: on-court-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on court-green fills.

tokens.name: smash-lime
tokens.usage: Signature accent: highlights, rank-ups, live states, the mark on dark grounds. A fill only: never text on light surfaces (1.2:1). Text on it is on-smash-lime.

tokens.name: on-smash-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on smash-lime fills (13.7:1).

tokens.name: rally-coral
tokens.usage: Social accent (kudos, new followers, notification dots), used sparingly. A fill only; text on it is on-rally-coral.

tokens.name: on-rally-coral
tokens.usage: Text on rally-coral fills (6.2:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Shuttle White in light, Net Navy in dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface and surface-raised (≥14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface and surface-raised (≥6.9:1 light, ≥7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders (decorative; never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input and toggle borders (≥3.4:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: court-line
tokens.usage: The court-line motif drawn over court-green (cover, splash, empty states).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset (≥5:1 on every surface in both themes).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word or icon. Text on surface in both themes (≥6.2:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines on the platform and club sites.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy. Vietnamese diacritics render fully.
styles.sample: Hẹn gặp bạn ở sân thứ Sáu này.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablets; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page sections on club sites.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, badges.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the app icon preview.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, segmented controls, chips, the tab bar's active pill.
